meta.title: 拉花纠错分享
meta.topic: 咖啡拉花 · 有奶泡却没线条的纠错

scenes.context: 打了细腻奶泡，倒进咖啡后表面却没有奶泡，拉花变成一坨。
sentences: 摇晃奶缸，奶泡摇起来很细腻。
Swirl the pitcher and the foam turns silky.
silky（细腻的）
倒进咖啡后表面却没有奶泡。
After pouring into the coffee, there's no foam on the surface.
surface（表面）
拉花变成一坨。
The latte art turns into a blob.
blob（一坨）
paraphrase: No foam appears on top of the coffee.
It just clumps together into a mess.
scenes.speak: Swirl the pitcher and the foam turns silky. After pouring into the coffee, there's no foam on the surface. The latte art turns into a blob.

scenes.context: 奶泡打完会分层，拉花前要先摇匀，让奶泡与牛奶重新融合。
sentences: 奶泡打完会分层。
Milk foam separates after you steam it.
separate（分层）
拉花前要先摇匀。
Swirl it well before pouring.
swirl（摇晃）
停了5秒就分层，没有流动性。
Leave it for five seconds and it separates — no more flow.
flow（流动性）
paraphrase: The foam and milk split apart when left to sit.
Give it a good swirl to re-combine the foam.
scenes.speak: Milk foam separates after you steam it. Swirl it well before pouring. Leave it for five seconds and it separates — no more flow.

scenes.title_en: Fix: Swirl and Pour with More Flow
scenes.context: 摇匀后再压低倒奶线条就出来了；图案小是因为流量不够大，要大流量才有推动力。
sentences: 摇匀后再压低倒奶，线条一根根往前跑。
After swirling, pour low and the lines run forward one by one.
pour low（压低倒奶）
拉花时一定要给足够大的流量。
You must give a generous flow when pouring.
generous flow（足够的流量）
流量大才有推动力，奶泡浮在表面。
A strong flow creates momentum, letting the foam ride on the surface.
momentum（推动力）
paraphrase: The pour needs force to push the foam around.
Keep the pitcher close to the surface as you pour.
scenes.speak: After swirling, pour low and the lines run forward one by one. You must give a generous flow when pouring. A strong flow creates momentum, letting the foam ride on the surface.

practice: 奶泡打完静置会发生什么？
The foam separates from the milk after a few seconds.
Swirl the pitcher to re-combine the foam and milk.
The flow isn't strong enough to push the pattern.
Give a generous, steady flow — not a slow drip.
pitfalls: 静置几秒奶泡就分层，先出来的是白奶。
流量不足时奶泡沉底，没有推动力。
footer_notes: ASR 校正：转录中「油质」按上下文修正为「奶泡/牛奶」语境。
